title: LineContinuity_Density mode params
description: Detects liquid boundaries as dips in per-row ridge density (ridges per unit height). Shares extractor params with all LineContinuity modes.

threshold.description: Normalised signal threshold for peak detection (0–1).

smooth_window.description: Moving-average smoothing window applied before peak detection. 1 = no smoothing.

min_distance.description: Minimum pixel distance between adjacent candidates.
